mumbai.name: Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai, at sunset
mumbai.far: the stadium's famous roof: a row of white tent-like fabric canopies with peaked tops held up by thin white masts and cables, over steep tiers of packed blue seats, and behind them the curve of Marine Drive along the Arabian Sea with art-deco buildings and the Mumbai skyline under a glowing orange sunset sky
mumbai.left: steep tiers of packed blue seats under the white peaked fabric canopy roof, a tall floodlight tower behind
mumbai.right: steep tiers of packed blue seats under the white peaked fabric canopy roof, palm trees and sea beyond
mumbai.near: more steep tiers of blue seats under the white peaked fabric canopies, the front of the canopy edge and its masts clearly visible
mumbai.crowd: chunky cartoon Mumbai fans in bright blue and gold shirts waving blue flags and drums
mumbai.light: warm golden sunset light from top-left with soft glow

chennai.name: MA Chidambaram Stadium (Chepauk), Chennai, on a hot sunny afternoon
chennai.far: the stadium's big modern stands with their striking white curved wave-shaped cantilever roofs over tiers of packed yellow seats, and beyond them the tall colourful carved gopuram tower of a South Indian temple, coconut palms and the Bay of Bengal under a hot blue sky
chennai.left: tiers of packed yellow seats under a white curved wave-shaped roof
chennai.right: tiers of packed yellow seats under a white curved wave-shaped roof, coconut palms behind
chennai.near: a modern stand of packed yellow seats under the white curved wave-shaped roof edge, clearly visible
chennai.crowd: chunky cartoon Chennai fans in bright yellow shirts and yellow hats, waving yellow flags and whistles
chennai.light: bright hot sun from top-right with soft glow

kolkata.name: Eden Gardens, Kolkata, on a lively evening under floodlights
kolkata.far: Eden Gardens' huge round bowl of tiered packed stands with purple and gold seats under a long white cantilever roof ring, tall floodlight towers, and beyond it the white marble domes of the Victoria Memorial and the steel Howrah Bridge under a deep blue evening sky
kolkata.left: the huge sweeping bowl of tiers packed with fans under the white roof ring
kolkata.right: the huge sweeping bowl of tiers packed with fans under the white roof ring, a floodlight tower above
kolkata.near: the near part of the huge bowl, tiers packed with fans under the white roof edge, clearly visible
kolkata.crowd: chunky cartoon Kolkata fans in purple and gold, waving purple flags
kolkata.light: bright floodlights with a deep blue evening sky

bangalore.name: M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, at night under floodlights
bangalore.far: the stadium's distinctive long white roof canopies made of rows of tensile fabric panels held up by thin masts and cables over tiers of packed red seats, tall floodlight towers, and green trees with the Bengaluru skyline beyond under a starry night sky
bangalore.left: tiers of packed red seats under the long white tensile fabric canopy roof
bangalore.right: tiers of packed red seats under the long white tensile fabric canopy roof, a floodlight tower behind
bangalore.near: tiers of packed red seats under the white tensile fabric canopy edge, clearly visible
bangalore.crowd: chunky cartoon Bengaluru fans in red and black, waving red flags
bangalore.light: bright white floodlights at night with soft glow

delhi.name: Arun Jaitley Stadium, Delhi, on a warm afternoon
delhi.far: the stadium's big modern stands with tiers of packed blue seats and boxy glass-fronted hospitality floors under flat white roofs, and beyond them the red sandstone Qutub Minar tower and the domes of old Delhi under a hazy blue sky
delhi.left: tiers of packed blue seats under a flat white roof
delhi.right: tiers of packed blue seats under a flat white roof, the edge of the old red fort walls beyond
delhi.near: a modern stand of packed blue seats with glass boxes and a flat white roof edge, clearly visible
delhi.crowd: chunky cartoon Delhi fans in blue and red, waving blue flags
delhi.light: warm afternoon sun from top-left with soft glow

jaipur.name: Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur, on a golden afternoon
jaipur.far: the stadium's pink-sandstone stands with Rajput-style arched balconies, little domed chhatri kiosks and scalloped arches over tiers of packed pink seats, and beyond them the pink honeycomb facade of the Hawa Mahal and hilltop forts under a golden sky
jaipur.left: tiers of packed pink seats in pink-sandstone stands with arched balconies and little domed chhatris
jaipur.right: tiers of packed pink seats in pink-sandstone stands with arched balconies and little domed chhatris
jaipur.near: a pink-sandstone stand with arched balconies, domed chhatris and packed pink seats, clearly visible
jaipur.crowd: chunky cartoon Jaipur fans in pink and blue with colourful turbans, waving pink flags
jaipur.light: warm golden afternoon sun from top-right with soft glow

hyderabad.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Hyderabad, at sunset
hyderabad.far: the stadium's big modern stands with tiers of packed orange seats under a long sweeping white roof, tall floodlight towers, and beyond them the four minarets of the Charminar and the Golconda fort hill under an orange sunset sky
hyderabad.left: tiers of packed orange seats under a long sweeping white roof
hyderabad.right: tiers of packed orange seats under a long sweeping white roof, rocky Deccan hills beyond
hyderabad.near: a modern stand of packed orange seats under the sweeping white roof edge, clearly visible
hyderabad.crowd: chunky cartoon Hyderabad fans in orange and black, waving orange flags
hyderabad.light: warm orange sunset light from top-left with soft glow

ahmedabad.name: Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, the world's biggest cricket ground, in the evening
ahmedabad.far: the gigantic modern circular bowl: huge steep tiers of packed blue seats rising very high, ringed by a continuous glowing LED light ring along its huge white roof edge, with tall white columns, and a sunset sky with kites flying above
ahmedabad.left: the gigantic steep bowl of packed blue seats under the white roof with its glowing LED ring
ahmedabad.right: the gigantic steep bowl of packed blue seats under the white roof with its glowing LED ring
ahmedabad.near: the near side of the gigantic bowl, steep tiers of packed seats and the glowing roof edge, clearly visible
ahmedabad.crowd: chunky cartoon Gujarat fans in navy blue and gold, waving navy flags
ahmedabad.light: warm evening light with the glowing LED ring and soft glow

mohali.name: the IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali, Punjab, on a sunny afternoon
mohali.far: the stadium's tall boxy modern pavilion with rows of glass windows and tiers of packed red seats, tall floodlight towers on the corners, and beyond them golden mustard fields, green farmland and the Shivalik hills under a blue sky
mohali.left: tiers of packed red seats in a low open stand, floodlight tower behind
mohali.right: tiers of packed red seats in a low open stand, mustard fields beyond
mohali.near: a modern stand of packed red seats with a glass-fronted building, clearly visible
mohali.crowd: chunky cartoon Punjab fans in red and silver, many in bright turbans, waving red flags and dhol drums
mohali.light: bright afternoon sun from top-right with soft glow

lucknow.name: Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow, at dusk
lucknow.far: the stadium's big modern stands with tiers of packed teal seats under a striking gold-and-white roof with curved lattice arches, and beyond them the domes and minarets of the Bara Imambara and the Rumi Darwaza gateway under a purple dusk sky
lucknow.left: tiers of packed teal seats under the gold-and-white lattice-arched roof
lucknow.right: tiers of packed teal seats under the gold-and-white lattice-arched roof
lucknow.near: a modern stand of packed teal seats under the gold-and-white lattice-arched roof edge, clearly visible
lucknow.crowd: chunky cartoon Lucknow fans in teal and orange, waving teal flags
lucknow.light: warm dusk light with glowing floodlights and soft glow
